name: OnlineGroupEyebrow - Over A Forming City Card
description: The caption over a forming city's homepage card: the globe and ONLINE · WHATSAPP GROUP in small muted mono capitals, above Seattle / Pacific Northwest and its blurb. It replaced a white Forming · help lead it pill, which the reviewer rejected twice as too loud. What to check is the left edge: with no background and no padding, the eyebrow starts exactly where the city name and blurb start, so it reads as part of one caption rather than a sticker on the photo.
